From the owner
📢 Important Notice We would like to inform our valued customers that this restaurant is not owned by us (Sugar 'N Spice) anymore and we are no longer associated with its operations in any capacity. Our franchise association with this outlet has officially ended, and it is now being independently owned and managed. As a result, we are not involved in its operations, food preparation, hygiene practices, service standards, or quality control. Any concerns regarding the current management of that outlet do not reflect the standards we uphold at our original establishments. We sincerely appreciate everyone who has supported Sugar 'N Spice over the years and thank those who have brought their concerns to our attention. We are excited to announce the opening of our new and Original Sugar N Spice Saputara next month, located next to Step Garden. We look forward to welcoming you back and serving you with the quality, hygiene, and hospitality that define our brand. Thank you for your continued trust and support. — Team Sugar 'N Spice Corporate Office Surat.
Jun 3, 2026
